ns2:course.label: Res Ethics & Responsibilities
ns2:course.description: Lecture/discussion course focusing on research ethics and a variety of related issues that can influence success in graduate school in the biological sciences, including scientific integrity and compliance with regulations for laboratory research. Approved for letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
